summary: Two nodes still lack a first-class relay identity, which blocks the O(N^2) mesh the owner asked for.
browserExtension: Has no relay credential at all; it only knows localhost:8000. Needs a new browser_node role (device:heartbeat:self, device:status:read, browser:work:claim, browser:work:complete, context:read). Must NOT reuse mac_bridge, which holds state:write over agent-snapshot/fleet plus bridge:work:claim.
ios: src/cloudClient.js already pairs as role mobile but the path had never been exercised. No mobile socket route exists: /v1/bridge/socket requires bridge:work:claim and is bound to a device BridgeHub.
securityNote: mobile holds mac:execute, the strongest scope in the table, on the most-stolen class of device. Decision taken: keep the capability, bound the blast radius with one-action revocation from the dashboard rather than a permanent restriction.
adminKeyStatus: Never committed to git across all 195 commits. But present in plaintext in 65 untracked files across 8 build trees, and in flash on a device that leaves the house. Treat as compromised; rotate.
